# Establishment log — popol-vuh-008 (image 0030 from line 9, 0031, 0032, and 0033 lines 1–17)

Read 2026-11-25 from source/pages/i0030 (from line 9, after `… cat oc vbic, xuchax cut.`), i0031, i0032 and the
first seventeen lines of i0033, in strips of about eight lines at 1×, with 2× crops of every doubtful word,
checked word by word against Brasseur 1861 (OCR lines 20939–21330). Start: `Vꜩ bala, xꜭha curi Zipacna …`
(0030 l.9). End: image 0032 ends mid-sentence (`… mabi chi couin chic rumal ri`); the sentence and the
Cabracan episode run on to 0033 l.17 (`… ruꜭ Cabracan, varal chuvach vleuh.`), where the closing summary ends.
popol-vuh-009 begins at 0033 l.17/18 with the next paragraph (Brasseur's chapter on the birth of the boys'
fathers; the MS then has the heading `Vae cate vꜩihoxic …` a few lines lower).

Content: Zipacna goes after the false crab under Meauan, the mountain falls on him and he turns to stone.
New episode: Cabracan, the second son, who shakes down mountains; Huracan, Chipi Caculha and Raxa Caculha
send the boys against him; they lure him east with talk of a great mountain, shoot birds with breath alone,
roast one coated with zahcab (earth), feed it to him; he weakens, they bind him and bury him. Closing
summary of the three defeats.

## Folios
Counting as 004–007 did (0027 = 9r): 0030 = 10v, 0031 = 11r, 0032 = 11v, 0033 = 12r → `fols. 10v–12r`. The
crop of 0032 carries 11 at the top left (again consistent with the folio doubt in QUESTIONS.md, 2026-11-24);
the earlier count is kept.

## Letter rule used (002–007's rules, unchanged)
- g-shaped letter → ꜭ: `ꜭaholab`, `ꜭahol` (all), `vꜭahol`, `ꜭo vi` (0031 last line / 0032), `ꜭo ca vvb`,
  `ꜭo ꜩiquin`, `ꜭohe`, `lal ꜭolic`, `ruꜭ Cabracan` (0033; the first `ruc` in the same line is plain c);
  gh → ꜭh: `xꜭha`, `xeꜭha`, `xꜭhauic`, `xuꜭhax`, `xe vꜭhax`.
- q-shaped letter where Brasseur has q (= ꜭ): `chi vꜭux` (0030), `lal Vꜭux Cah`, `vꜭuxlal`, `vꜭux` (0032).
- q-shaped letter where Brasseur has g → ꜫ: `ꜫih` (sun) throughout (`relebal ꜫih`, `chi be ꜫih`, `couizah ꜫih`).
- tresillo (ɛ-shaped) → ꜫ: `ꜫan vbolic` (0032; B. gan).
- plain c / qu kept where Brasseur has g, q or k: `vcab` ×2 'his hand' (0032–0033; B. u gab; 005 printed vꜫab
  where the image had the tresillo), `qui cab` (B. qui gab), `qui cac` / `chuvach cac` (B. gag 'fire'),
  `xa co quil` (B. qo), `mi xca cam` (B. ka qam), `ca quilo` (B. ka kilo), `cauahin` (B. gavahin),
  `cabiquilahic` (B. gabiquilahic), `cuz` (B. guz), `vcaxah` (B. u gaxah), `chi cama` (B. Ch'y gama),
  `xuquiz` (B. x-u qiz), `cacvacavoh`, `pacal`/`pacalic` (as 007), `caquiye` (B. cakiye), `qui couic` and
  `qui couizah` (B. qu'iqovic, qu'iqouizah).
- `quih` (0032, the bird's juice) is written with qu + u as Brasseur `quih`; kept, not ꜫih.
- tz ligature → ꜩ: `Vꜩ` ×4, `ꜩalam`, `cumaꜩih`, `quiꜩih` ×5, `cuꜩin`, `vꜩlo`, `xꜩolcopih`, `v ꜩihoxic`, `nu ꜩih`,
  `vꜩih`, `ꜩarabom`, `ꜩiquin` (all), `chu ꜩica`, `ꜩac` ×2, `xuꜩonoh`, `xuꜩinic`.
- ß-ligature read ti (as 005–007): `cu tih` (0030; B. cu tih), `chutinih` (0031; B. ch'utinih), `chuti`
  (B. chuti), `qui tihtobela` (0032), `chi tihic` (0032, see below), `xutio` (0033; B. x-u tio), `xtilob` (0030,
  see below).
- `Cabrracan` with rr is printed as written wherever the MS has it (8×); `Cabracan` with one r where it has one (6×).

## Doubtful readings and decisions against Brasseur
- 0030 l.17 `xa xrah hupunic` (MS `rixa xrah`), B. `ri xa x-r'ah hupunic`; as B.
- 0030 l.18–19 `xacanic` (MS `xa|canic`), one word (B. x-akanic 'went up').
- 0030 l.29 `xtilob`: x + a tall looped letter + i + `lob`; read with the ti ligature; Brasseur's OCR garbled
  (`х-Шор`). Meaning unknown; doubtful. Could be `xhilob`.
- 0030 l.30 `chi vꜭux`: q-shaped, with Brasseur (u qux).
- 0030 l.37–38 `xchi ca biyh`: the MS has `byh` with a small mark above the y; printed `biyh` as the earlier
  parts (002 l.28 of its log; 007). Same at 0031 (`chi bochiyh`, MS `bochyh`; `qui biyh`, MS `quibyh`) and 0033
  (`mi xca biyh`, MS `mi xcabißh`?).
- 0031 l.1 `ri Huracan`: the first word heavily inked; read `ri` with Brasseur.
- 0031 l.9 `cu` is written above the line over `bochyh`, with Brasseur (`Ch'y bochiyh cu ubic`); printed in place.
- 0031 l.6 `ca qui couizah`: plain z (a heavy bar on the z, not the ligature).
- 0031 l.14 `iohol huyub` with i here (yohol at 0030 l.39 and 0031 l.21): printed as written.
- 0031 l.20 `vliy`: MS `vly` with a superscript i; printed `vliy` with Brasseur (uliy).
- 0031 l.31 `xa co quil caquiye`: plain c in `co`; Brasseur `xa qo qu'il cakiye`. Printed as the image.
- 0031 l.40 `Xchi vil na` (MS `xchivilna`), B. `K-chi vil na`.
- 0032 l.2 `Chi cama ca be` (MS `chicama|cabe`), B. `Ch'y gama ka be` ('show us the road'); plain c.
- 0032 l.21–22 `chire ta hiconoc` (MS `chire tahiconoc`), B. `chire, ta higon-oc`; division as B., meaning unclear.
- 0032 l.25 `puleu … puvleu`: the MS writes `pu|leu` then `pu|vleu`; both printed as written (B. p'uleu ×2).
- 0032 l.27–28 `hun ꜩac, hun bit ta chanax oc, ta zaquir oc`: the second z is a plain z with a tail, not the
  ligature (B. zakir-oc). Brasseur calls the sentence obscure; so it is.
- 0032 l.30 `chi tihic`: a heavy blot sits on the ligature; `chi` + ß + `ic`; read `tihic` ('eating', the tih of
  0030); Brasseur's OCR garbled (`бус`). Doubtful.
- 0032 l.30 `chi chacuxic`: Brasseur `chi hakuxic`; the image has a small c before `hacuxic`. Printed `chacuxic`;
  doubtful.
- 0032 l.34–35 `chi yipouic`: MS `chiyipo|uic`, Brasseur's OCR garbled (`BONE`). Read y-i-p; doubtful.
- 0032 l.35 `chi cabchiyanic` (B. cabehiyanic, OCR).
- 0033 l.6 `vcul racan vcabichal`, as B. (`u cul rakan u cabichal`).
- 0033 l.9 `xqui mucu` (B. x-qui muku).
- No supralinear words other than `cu` (0031).

## Word division (ours)
`xu ban chic` (MS `xubanchic`), `xu vlih tah`, `Ma cu habi` (MS `macuhabi`), `mi xca cam`, `ca bi` (MS `cabi`,
B. ka bi), `xa co quil`, `chi ca xol`, `hun cha mox`, `hun cha vi qui cab`, `ta pu chi` (MS `tapuchi`),
`xchacou re` (MS `xchacoure`), `chi be zac`, `v cab` 'the second' (as against `vcab` 'his hand'), `v vi vchec`.

## Paragraphs
Ximénez writes continuously except for the new section at 0030 l.39 (large R, `Rox chicut nimarizai rib`).
Paragraphs cut at speech turns and narrative joints as in 006–007 (27 paragraphs).
